tagline: Control the TV from your phone
g_desc: Move your ball and score in the hoop on the far side. Go in gently: a fast ball bounces off. 90 seconds.
g_hint: Red scores on the right and blue on the left. A goal within 5 seconds is worth 3 points, within 10 seconds 2 points, after that 1 point. If no second player joins, the computer plays instead.
h_desc: Move the mallet with your finger and hit the puck into the other goal. First to 7 goals wins.
h_hint: Red plays on the left and black on the right. If no second player joins, the computer plays instead.
j_desc: Eat to grow. Do not hit yourself or the other snake. Leave one edge of the screen and you come back from the opposite one. 90 seconds, the longest snake wins.
j_hint: A red pellet is 1 point and a golden one is 3. You can put your own face on the snake with the ⚙️ button inside the game.
draw_hint: Every phone draws with its own colour and tools at the same time. “Undo” removes only your own last stroke. “Enlarge canvas” fills the phone screen; turn the phone sideways for calligraphy.
laser_tilt: Move the pointer by tilting the phone
laser_hint: The pointer disappears by itself after 4 seconds and uses your pen colour. The spotlight dims the screen and leaves one clear circle.
mic_lock: Lock the microphone (tap to start, tap to stop)
mic_hint: Your voice comes out of the TV speakers. Keep the phone away from the TV to avoid echo.
mic_secure: The browser allows the microphone only on the secure link. Open it, and when the “connection is not private” warning appears choose “Advanced”, then “Proceed”.
pic_pick: 📷 Choose a picture and show it
prank_sound: Prank sounds (breaking glass and fly buzz)
prank_hint: “Cracked screen”: every tap adds more cracks. “Fly”: one tap brings it, a second tap makes it fly away. “Lion” takes 7 seconds: a black frame closes on the screen, the lion runs in from far away and jumps out of the frame.
prayer_on: Show the alert on the TV
prayer_at: Second alert when the prayer time starts
prayer_try: Try the alert on the TV
show_qr: Show the QR code on the TV
qr_hint: The QR code lets anyone on the same Wi-Fi open this page on their phone.
tilt_control: Steer by tilting the phone instead of your finger
stick_hint: Put your finger anywhere here and move it
stick_hint_g: The stick appears under your finger
h_opt_hint: The white box is your half of the table as you see it on the TV, and the red line is the centre line.
face_hint: Drag and zoom the picture until your face is inside the circle.
stick_hint_j: The snake turns that way and keeps moving
mic_unavailable: The microphone is not available on this device.
mic_denied: Could not open the microphone: allow this site to use it and try again.
mic_live: 🔴 You are live on the TV…
snd_err: ❌ The TV could not play sound.
snd_muted: ⚠️ The TV box volume is at zero or muted.
snd_ok: ✅ The TV box played the sound. If you did not hear it, turn the TV volume up and try from the home screen.
voice_got: The TV received {0} seconds of audio
pic_done: The picture is on the TV ✓
prayer_times: Today's times ({0}): {1}. The TV clock now shows {2}; if that is wrong, fix the time and time zone in the TV box settings.
clear_confirm: Clear all drawings from the TV, for everyone?
no_motion_play: The browser gave no motion data. Open the secure (https) link from the microphone section, or play with your finger.
color_taken: Another player already has this colour, try the other one.
face_done: Your face is on the snake ✓
face_failed: The picture was not sent, try again.
no_motion_laser: The browser gave no motion data. Open the secure (https) link from the microphone section, or move the pointer by touch.
voice_not_played: (but the TV has not played it yet)
